annotations.title: Measure a distance or an area

description: Use when the user asks how long a line is or how large an area is. Give points as [[lon, lat], ...]; closed=true reads them as a polygon (the first point need not be repeated). Returns the geodesic (WGS84 ellipsoid) length of a line in km with each segment and its bearing, or the area (km² and ha) and perimeter of a polygon.

closed.description: true: a polygon (area); false: a line.

name: measure_distance_or_area
